subject: Vendr portal delegation & evidence sync (S3 bucket handover)
messages:
From: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Carlos Lopez <carlos@vendr.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal: next steps for Greenfield Health profile

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for signing up Greenfield Health in Vendr. To complete ownership and rotate the existing S3 evidence bundle we need: 1) confirmation of the new portal owner, 2) a signed owner-transfer form, and 3) temporary read-only IAM permissions to the S3 bucket where evidence is staged.

I attached the owner transfer form and a short checklist. Once we have the form and an IAM principal that we can use (ARN or federated role), we’ll pull the evidence zip and confirm the feed.

A couple notes:
- If you want Vendr to remain the primary owner but add a second admin, tell us the email; we can add that in minutes.
- If you prefer us to import evidence from a shared Drive link, include a Drive share link with view access.

Best,
Carlos Lopez
Vendr Onboarding

Attachments: vendr_owner_transfer_form.pdf (PDF, 48KB); onboarding-checklist.txt (TXT, 2KB)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: next steps for Greenfield Health profile

Carlos — thanks.

We want Redwood to be the primary owner for this integration (customer request), with Greenfield Health listed as the account. I’m attaching the signed transfer form (signed electronically by myself) and a small IAM policy that grants read-only List/Get access to the evidence bucket.

IAM details:
- Principal: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/vendr-importer
- Policy: s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket scoped to arn:aws:s3:::greenfield-evidence/*

Neha — can you confirm the bucket name/permissions on your side and schedule the short window for Vendr to pull the evidence? Mateo — FYI on the handoff — we may need you to confirm checksums post-import.

I’ve also added a shared Drive folder for any non-S3 artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-evidence-sync

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Ops (Security & Compliance)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendr_owner_transfer_form_signed.pdf; s3_permission_policy.json

From: Carlos Lopez <carlos@vendr.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: next steps for Greenfield Health profile

Thanks Vanessa — got the signed form and the IAM principal. We’ll attempt an import during the maintenance window you provide. Two quick things before we pull:

1) Please confirm the bucket region (us-west-2) and that objects are not encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key unless you provide a decrypt policy.
2) We ran a quick scan of the Drive folder and flagged one file (report_draft.docx) that looks like a draft — does that need to be included in the compliance bundle?

Tentative schedule: Tue 10 Aug 2027 22:00–22:30 PDT (we’ll keep it to 30m). If that works, we’ll send a short DocuSign link for the final acknowledgement and a ticket link to track progress: https://vendr.com/tickets/654321

Thanks,
Carlos

Attachments: none

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: next steps for Greenfield Health profile

Vanessa — confirmed:
- Bucket: greenfield-evidence (us-west-2)
- No CMK encryption on objects (default AES256)
- We’ve staged the evidence zip(s) under folder /incoming/vendr-import/ and pre-computed SHA256 checksums in evidence-checklist.csv (attached).

We’re good for the Tue 22:00 PDT window. I’ll open a temporary IP allowlist for the Vendr importer role and disable it once the pull completes. Mateo — please watch for the checksum confirmation and validate the archive integrity.

Neha Kapoor
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-checklist.csv

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Carlos Lopez <carlos@vendr.com>, Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: next steps for Greenfield Health profile

Thanks all — Tue 22:00 PDT confirmed.

Carlos: DocuSign acknowledgement is signed (link in ticket). We’ve allowed your importer role and will remove access after the import; Neha has the checklist and will confirm checksums once complete.

One small ask from Greenfield Health: please do not import report_draft.docx — that file is a product roadmap doc and not part of the SOC2 bundle. If you see it during the pull, skip it.

If anything slips, report back on the ticket and loop me in.

Best,
Vanessa

Attachments (for internal reference): s3_permission_policy.json
